description: Mac App Store app metadata from Apple's public iTunes Lookup API by App Store id: name, seller, version, price, average rating and rating count (0 when Apple shows none), genre and store link. Mac apps only. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_apple_app_store_iphone when you need App Store iPhone app metadata from Apple's public iTunes; dev_apple_app_store_reviews when you need App Store customer reviews of one iOS app from Apple's. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

id.description: Mac App Store track id, digits only, e.g. 497799835 (Xcode)
